title: Task file
description: A repository's tasks at a commit (D203). A Tasks schema's build writes it, and a forge reads it. A reader refuses a field this schema does not name and a version newer than it reads. Three places are open by design: an input's spec, sections.<name> and a task's sections.<name>.

image.description: The digest of the image a task runs from unless it names its own. The plan command ships in it.

platform.description: The platform a task runs on unless it names its own.

sections.description: By section name, the part of each section that belongs to the file. Open: only the reader that registered a section reads it.

task.description: One unit of work. Every field but after and sections is a work field, which the input key reads.

run.description: The command, an argument list. Nothing starts a shell.

inputs.description: What the task reads of the commit.

uses.description: The outputs of other tasks this one reads. Each enters the key by the other task's key.

after.description: The tasks that must pass before this one starts, and from which it reads nothing. It enters no key.

outputs.description: The named results the task declares.

services.description: The service containers the task runs beside.

env.description: The environment the command starts with.

image.description: The digest of the image this task runs from, in place of the file's.

platform.description: The platform this task runs on, in place of the file's.

hermetic.description: False for a task whose result its inputs do not decide. It has no key and is never reused.

sections.description: By section name, the part of each section that belongs to this task. Open.

input.description: One input: the kind of the resolver that turns it into tracked files, and the spec that resolver reads. Open: a registered resolver adds a kind and checks its spec.

output.description: One named result: the files at paths, an image's digest, or a value.

service.description: One service container, by its image's digest.
